title: Conditional κ = 0.00363206219 (+0.00000039227 over #7003): peer MOVE retiming
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Retiming one ADD and delaying its peer MOVE lets two paid P104 moves fuse. The complete 18-LOCAL caller now makes 117,504 paid requests, down from 117,522. The target profile and rank-mass surplus are preserved.

The new conditional saving is **κ = 363206219/100000000000 = 0.00363206219**, up **39227/100000000000 = 0.00000039227** over #7003. The independent rational crossing interval is (0.00363206219577303624414255882815714, 0.00363206219577303624414255882815715). The claimed rational is strictly above #7003’s certified upper endpoint 0.00363166992015115785886325297974981.

## Task and overlap

This PR is stacked on #7003 at ec30476096b2f9aed718152a2fa3712d1c4e884d so its exact source pins are available to the hosted replay. The [incremental diff](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/compare/ec30476096b2f9aed718152a2fa3712d1c4e884d...2ee11a4460f23abf06d16b12f18c8ef9aca889f1) adds one package, research/peer-move-retiming/. The p104-side-correction scope changes to a contact-free peer MOVE delay after the fixed-cut screen on #7003 found no remaining stop. Related #6932 retiming retains this particular two-hop stop.

## Validation

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/peer-move-retiming

The registered local replay passed in 104.58 seconds from the exact #7003 checkout with the successor patch applied. It reproduced the frozen [certificate](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2ee11a4460f23abf06d16b12f18c8ef9aca889f1/research/peer-move-retiming/RESULT.json), independently certified the complete price, and passed the finite physical replay on all 400 main and 1,080 helper outputs. It rejected a scalar mutation, wrong phase, insufficient grid, and the new claim at the old invoice. Expected output includes PASS_PEER_MOVE_RETIMING 0.00363206219 3.9227E-7 and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE. The predecessor’s [hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42774552945) passed.

## Credit and open questions

See the [construction proof, credits, and next questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2ee11a4460f23abf06d16b12f18c8ef9aca889f1/research/peer-move-retiming/README.md). The same five framework assumptions and broader #7003 contracts apply. Full fixed-tape and rounded provider admission and the #6998 physical tariff bridge remain open. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
